press_references.value: Sohar International introduces Marriage Loan with exclusive benefits for newly married couples

product_launches.description: Sohar International launched a new 0% interest Marriage Loan product for eligible Omani men entering their first marriage, offering financing up to OMR 2,000 with up to 24-month repayment and cashback benefits linked to the wife’s be Zahiya account.

press_references.value: Sohar International introduces a comprehensive banking ecosystem for pensioners

product_launches.description: Sohar International has launched a dedicated Pensioners Account banking product in Oman, offering pensioners preferential deposit and financing rates, a lifetime free credit card, healthcare partnerships, lifestyle privileges, and priority services tailored to retirees’ needs.

press_references.value: Sohar Islamic launches SME debit card with no annual fees

product_launches.description: Sohar Islamic, the Islamic banking window of Sohar International, launched a Shariah-compliant SME Debit Card with no annual fee to support transactional and cash-flow needs of small and medium-sized enterprises in Oman and abroad.

press_references.value: Sohar International and Sohar Islamic introduce Ramadan auto financing campaign with rates starting from 3.45%

product_launches.description: Sohar International and its Islamic window Sohar Islamic launched a Ramadan auto finance campaign offering auto loans and Shariah-compliant financing with rates starting from 3.45% and tenors up to 10 years, plus bundled benefits like complimentary vehicle registration and motor protection support.

press_references.value: Sohar International and Visa Launch “She’s Next” to Boost Women Entrepreneurs in Oman

product_launches.description: Sohar International and Visa jointly launched the "She’s Next" program in Oman, a new initiative providing financial support, mentorship, and capability-building for women-led businesses, with a prize pool of OMR 38,000.

press_references.value: Sohar International launches exclusive Auto Loan Special Offers in partnership with leading automotive distributors

product_launches.description: Sohar International and its Islamic window Sohar Islamic launched a new Auto Loan Special Offers product bundle with discounted pricing, 0% financing, and added benefits for vehicle buyers in Oman.

press_references.value: Sohar International introduces Oman’s first credit card offering 3% cashback

product_launches.description: Sohar International launched a new 3% Cashback Credit Card, touted as Oman’s first to offer 3% cashback credited monthly, with Visa acceptance and added perks like lounge access, emergency assistance, and extended warranty.

press_references.value: Sohar International & Sohar Islamic introduce new housing finance product for GCC nationals and expatriates

product_launches.description: Sohar International, together with its Islamic window Sohar Islamic, launched a new Housing Finance product for GCC nationals and expatriates investing in Oman ITC properties, offering up to 50% financing (max OMR 250,000), tenors up to 10 years, an 18‑month grace for under‑construction units, conventional or Shariah options, and a complementary credit card facility up to USD 10,000.

press_references.value: Sohar International launches Oman’s first open banking platform, ushering a new era of financial innovation

product_launches.description: Sohar International has officially launched Oman's first open banking platform, providing businesses and fintechs with integrated, secure, and compliant access to banking services via open APIs. This move is expected to drive financial innovation and inclusion in Oman.

overview_description.description: ​Sohar International is a financial institution that offers a wide range of services, including retail and corporate banking, investment services, and treasury operations. The organization provides products such as personal and housing loans, credit cards, insurance, and digital banking solutions. It operates through multiple segments, including wholesale, retail, government and project finance syndication, investments, and treasury.

product.description: Visa credit cards, domestic debit cards, prepaid cards, corporate cards, and digital-wallet payment options for purchases, cash access, and expense management.

product.description: Online, mobile, corporate mobile, and ATM/CDM banking services for account management, payments, transfers, and other self-service transactions.
